text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to remove the existing single metered parking spot on the south side of Rowanwood Avenue, east of Yonge Street, as it is no longer required. The metered parking spot will be replaced with an existing maximum one-hour parking limit bylaw in order to be consistent with the parking regulations on Rowanwood Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing metered parking in effect from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, and from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. on Saturday, at a rate of $1.50 per hour for a maximum period of 2 hours, on the south side of Rowanwood Avenue, between a point 30.5 metres east of Yonge Street and the Yonge subway overpass. 2. Rescinded the existing metered parking in effect from 6:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., Monday to Saturday, and from 1:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. on Sunday, at a rate of $1.50 per hour for a maximum period of 3 hours, on the south side of Rowanwood Avenue, between a point 30.5 metres east of Yonge Street and the Yonge subway overpass.
